title: Golden Lady Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the picturesque town of Seaside, Florida, Golden Lady is a golden dream! This spacious and serene 2 bedroom/ 2.5 bath cottage is located on Grayton Street, just west of the town square with a loft space that allows you to sleep 6-8 comfortably!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in Seaside with access to the private beach at the Natchez Pavilion - 30 Second walk to the largest, family pool - 2 Queen suites with cable TV access plus additional sleeping spaces - Walking/biking distance to Seaside, shops and restaurants - Spacious outdoor patios - Fully stocked kitchen - Two adult beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Upon entering Golden Lady, you'll enjoy the Seaside popular designed "flip flop" floor plan with the 2 main sleeping areas on the first floor and the living/dining space upstairs. Each of the 2 guestrooms offers a queen bed with private on-suite bathroom. One of the bathrooms has a shower/bath combo, while the other is shower only. The laundry is located in the hallway. Upstairs you're greeted with a two-story living room that is both open and bright. A large dining table that seats 6 comfortably, a half bath and a crisp, white, fully equipped kitchen completes the second floor. Up one more set of stairs is a loft space with a trundle bed that sleeps 2 more people. Off the loft is a covered balcony with outdoor seating. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 6-8) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Queen / private bathroom (shower/bath combo), TV Bedroom 2: Queen / private bathroom (shower only), TV 2nd floor- Pull out queen sized couch in great room, TV, kitchen and dining, half bath 3rd floor - Loft with trundle day bed. Located in the picturesque town of Seaside, Florida, and only 6 houses from the beach Golden Lady is a golden dream! This spacious and serene 2 bedroom/ 2.5 bath cottage is located on Grayton Street, just west of the town square. The home features a loft space on the third level and a pull-out queen sofa in the great room which allows you to sleep up to 8 in the home. For more sleeping space inquire about Golden Lady's sister property, Rena's Smile! When rented together this becomes a 4 bedroom with loft, sleeping up to 14. Kick back and enjoy the best of the emerald coast at Golden Lady! IMPORTANT DETAILS: * Parking for 2 cars ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. ** Golden Lady is attached on the second level with outside decking to its sister property Rena's Smile. The homes are completely private for different groups, with their own outdoor, private seating spaces and separate outdoor showers, however, can be rented together as a great dual family option as well. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
